## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of what this pull request does and which issue it addresses.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Test improvement

## Verification & Testing
Describe the tests you ran to verify your changes. Include test commands and results:
- [ ] Backend test suite passes (`pytest backend/tests -v`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly (`npm --prefix frontend run build`)
- [ ] Verified that protected database files (`backend/library.db`) are unmodified
- [ ] Verified that no secrets or API keys are present in diffs

## Checklist
